Pool germination curves across treatments

Source: R/germination.R
rescale_cum_frac.Rd

Recomputes cumulative germination fractions after pooling treatments: the germination increments of every curve (identified by TrtID) in a group are summed at each observation time and re-accumulated. The pooled curve is scaled to reach the highest final fraction observed in the group.

Usage

rescale_cum_frac(data, groups)

Arguments

data

A data frame with TrtID, CumTime, and CumFraction columns and any columns named in groups.

groups

Columns to keep; curves sharing the same values of these columns are pooled. Use character() to pool everything.

Value

A tibble with the groups columns, CumTime, and the pooled CumFraction.

See also

Other germination data helpers: calc_cum_frac(), clean_germ_data(), germ_speed(), pbtm_columns, plot_germ_data(), validate_germ_data()

Examples

# pool the replicate treatments at each temperature
rescale_cum_frac(germination_data, groups = "GermTemp")
#> # A tibble: 102 × 3
#>    GermTemp CumTime CumFraction
#>       <dbl>   <dbl>       <dbl>
#>  1       15      95      0.0625
#>  2       15     101      0.0833
#>  3       15     103      0.104 
#>  4       15     106      0.125 
#>  5       15     108      0.167 
#>  6       15     110      0.208 
#>  7       15     112      0.25  
#>  8       15     115      0.281 
#>  9       15     118      0.344 
#> 10       15     120      0.396 
#> # ℹ 92 more rows
